summary: Configures a force-feedback/input device stage: resets stage control flags at this+0x3F8, calls three device-vtable methods (poll at +0x64, state read at +0x24, and a query at +0xC that fills a parameter block at this+0x2C8), then sets the flags to 6271 and ORs in axis-count bits derived from the axis count at this+0x2DC. When the capability bit 0 at this+0x2CC is set, calls CollisionResponseCompute once per force-feedback axis (up to 8) to compute per-axis stage parameters. Returns 0 on success, -1 when the device pointer at this+0x80 is null or a device call fails.

operations.description: Reset the stage control flags at this+0x3F8 to null.
If the device pointer at this+0x80 is null, return -1.
Call the device vtable method at slot +0x64 (poll/flush) on the device.
Call the device vtable method at slot +0x24 with an 80-byte buffer; on non-zero return return -1.
Set the stage control flags at this+0x3F8 to 6271.
Call the device vtable method at slot +0xC, passing the parameter block pointer this+0x2C8; on non-zero return return -1.
Read the axis count from this+0x2DC and OR successive stage-flag bits into this+0x3F8: 0x400 when greater than 3, 0x200 when greater than 2, 0x100 when greater than 1, and 0x80 when non-zero.
If the capability flag bit 0 at this+0x2CC is set, configure the per-axis collision response stages.
Loop over 8 force-feedback axes, deriving a per-axis stage offset (0, 4, 8, ..., 28) for each index.
Call CollisionResponseCompute once per axis with the range and response parameter buffers at this+0x338/0x358/0x378 and this+0x40/0x60/0x318 plus axis-scaled inputs, for up to 8 axes.
